name.value: Marianne and Edward Gibson Art Museum

description.value: The Marianne and Edward Gibson Art Museum is a new purpose-built public art museum on SFU's Burnaby Mountain campus that opened in Fall 2025, consolidating SFU Galleries' collections into a single, more accessible facility. It mounts contemporary visual art exhibitions, public commissions, residencies, and a wide array of public programs rooted in decolonial and interdisciplinary approaches. The museum sits directly beside the SFU Transit Exchange at the top of Burnaby Mountain, making it a notable cultural destination reachable from across Metro Vancouver.

No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, racks, etc.) appear anywhere in the website content, so those remain null; the OSM record also carries no relevant cycling tags.
